Spherical harmonic synthesis (``gshs``)
========================================

The :mod:`pyharmgrav.gshs` submodule synthesizes gravity-field quantities at
scattered points or on a regular geographic grid.

Point synthesis
---------------

.. autofunction:: pyharmgrav.gshs.point_sh_synthesis

Grid synthesis
--------------

.. autofunction:: pyharmgrav.gshs.grid_sh_synthesis
